text:
Maya Rao: Quick callout 00 we need a concise rollout guardrail for 'adaptive-routing-v2' (flags + canaries + tenant opt-outs). Proposing: shadow -> 1% -> 10% -> gradual GA.

Theo Nguyen: +1. Suggest gating on p95 and 5xx rate; use relative deltas for small slices.

Riley Park: For region differences, let's use baseline offsets rather than a single absolute p95. APAC baseline is higher so thresholds should be baseline + delta.

Connor Hale: Add an exclusion list in flag metadata so sales/support can opt heavy customers out quickly. Also include a manual global kill switch.

Maya Rao: Rollout windows: small stages (1%) hold 45m stable, medium (10%) hold 4h. No promotions during region peak hours.

Theo Nguyen: Success criteria proposal: p95 delta <= +150ms, 5xx delta <= +0.2pp, cost per 1k tokens delta <= +8%, min sample 5k requests per slice.

Riley Park: Also auto-decay rule: if requests < 50 in 24h for a slice, revert and alert on-call.

Connor Hale: ops-bot: schedule smoke: 2025-04-02T03:00:00Z (shadow + 1% warmup)  toggle:adaptive-routing-v2, owner:@maya

Maya Rao: I'll update the flag manifest and runbook. Theo/Riley to add region baseline table. Connor to add kill-switch instructions and PD alerts.

Theo Nguyen: Dropping a short spreadsheet with baselines by EOD.

Riley Park: Noted, will review and confirm thresholds.

Connor Hale: Will add an exclusion tag and test kill path in staging.

Maya Rao: Thanks everyone. Aim to cut the shadow in staging tomorrow. :thumbsup:
